title: Candidate pattern: artifact-level release proof
summary: Prove the actual package or image that will ship: inspect its contents, boot or execute it, verify version and deployment identity, retain provenance, and document rollback before promotion.
incompatible_when: The deliverable has no independently built artifact and deployment is fully source-addressed with equivalent immutable identity proof.
procedure: Build once and identify the exact candidate artifact by immutable version and digest.
Inspect package or image contents for required files and forbidden local residue.
Boot or execute the built artifact in a clean environment and run a minimal functional smoke test.
Verify runtime version and deployment identity match the release candidate.
Capture provenance, checksums, and rollback or deprecation instructions before promotion.
verification: Run artifact-content checks and a clean-environment boot smoke against the exact candidate.
After deployment, compare reported version or digest with the promoted artifact and verify the rollback target.
rollback: Deprecate or unpromote the bad artifact, repoint to the last known-good immutable digest, and retain incident evidence.

confidence.rationale: OmniRoute provides artifact checks and a detailed release checklist, but the generalized pattern remains unproven elsewhere.
